mentions.name: Polished karting logger (school project)
mentions.description: A more polished version of the karting session logging app, planned as a school project with a Python backend using SQLite and Flask. The frontend will be mostly forms- and grids-based with simple client-side logic such as validation, geolocation, and a stopwatch; frontend technology is still being decided.
mentions.audience: The author's son, as a school project building on the collected karting dataset
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m deliberately doing this all in a very low-tech way as my son will be creating a more polished version for a school project. We’re front-running that a bit to give him a good dataset and explore various ideas. On that note, they do Python in school. For the backend it will be SqlLite and Flask.
